name.ja: サウザンド・サニー号 ワノ国編Ver.

ja: 麦わら海賊団一味の装いも新たに、ワノ国編仕様のサニー号を立体化！
• 全高約360mm。新規造形でワノ国編衣装の麦わら海賊団を再現。
• ガオン砲とパドルは差し替えで再現可能。
• カイナスシールと水転写式デカールで、ワノ国潜入時に負ったダメージの修復後を再現できる。
• シロモクバ１号、ミニメリー２号、シャークサブマージ３号が付属。
• 専用ディスプレイベース付属。
en: The Straw Hat Pirates have a new look, and the Sunny from the Wano Country edition has been made into a three-dimensional figure!
• Overall height approximately 360mm. The Straw Hat Pirates in their Wano Country costume are recreated with new modeling.
• Gaon cannon and paddle can be reproduced by replacing them.
• With Kynas Seal and water transfer decals, you can recreate the damage sustained when infiltrating Wano Country after it has been repaired.
• Shiromokuba No. 1, Mini Merry No. 2, and Shark Submerge No. 3 are included.
• Comes with a dedicated display base.

ja: シャークサブマージ3号×1
